stories.new_fact: AP reported Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress.

stories.new_fact: Ohio county boards may begin the official canvass November 8 and must complete it by November 24.
stories.new_takeaway: Local results move from unofficial reporting to record reconciliation and certification.
stories.why_now: The effective canvass date is November 8.
stories.previous_coverage: Earlier episodes addressed voting and initial Columbus results, not the canvass start.
stories.uncertainty: County timing and any close-contest dispute may vary.

stories.new_fact: Anthropic’s Personal Finance beta connects selected accounts through Plaid for read-only questions.
stories.new_takeaway: Read-only aggregation can still yield stale, duplicated or incomplete conclusions, making reconciliation more important than fluent summaries.
stories.why_now: The US beta and documentation were published November 6.
stories.previous_coverage: No account-data finance-assistant segment appeared in the previous seven scripts.
stories.uncertainty: No independent accuracy or user-outcome study is disclosed.
